distribution.narrative: Accepted for Taiwan from Beaver & Liu (2010). The 2010 synopsis states that Cryphalus formosanus is known only from the holotype; no broader mainland China occurrence is promoted.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host as unknown; no host taxon is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus formosanus Schedl, 1942.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus formosanus Schedl, 1942, VSN_1695. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Cryphalus formosanus with authorship Schedl.
